gaps.explanation: p8 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints four enterprise fund columns (Electric, Water, Sewer, Sanitation) with no schedule of their own; detail[] has no business-type lines. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 2,001,944 + sale of assets 8,235 + interest income 72,366 = 2,082,545. Per column: Electric 1,205,109 + 164,328 + 7,607 + 2,745 + 39,750 = 1,419,539; Water 204,724 + 72,544 + 1,327 + 2,745 + 9,204 = 290,544; Sewer 117,217 + 13,275 = 130,492; Sanitation 216,068 + 13,020 + 2,745 + 10,137 = 241,970. Sum 2,082,545 = statement 2,082,545. Internal Service Fund column excluded.
